info.title: EquipRent REST API — reviewed contract subset
info.description: Design proposal for 13 operations, not a deployed API or full contract for all 266 catalogue entries. Evidence: source commit 70766035a1ecbd5b30ac5ca4acaf6b0323431cf0. Business rules and proposed deltas are explicit x-extensions; these are not automatically enforced by schema validators. No authentication issuance or staff permission model is frozen here.

get.x-authorization-policy: Public safe projection; never enrich based on an unverified bearer header.
x-business-rules: Map to search_guest_machines. Use a fixed parameterized RPC adapter and response allowlist. Never fetchMachine or SELECT *.
lat and lng supplied together; search coordinates are caller site coordinates, never return precise yard location.
startDate/endDate supplied together. Start today..today+29 in Asia/Kolkata; end>=start and end-start<=89 days.
startMinute/durationMinutes together and only with a single-day range; sum<=1440. Cross-field and relative-date checks are service validation, not enforced by independent query schemas.
Bounds all four fields, south<=north; support antimeridian crossing west>east.
Server determines publication/KYC/moderation/operator eligibility and service-radius availability. total is exact before limit/offset, ID is stable sort tie-breaker.
withOperator omitted means no operator filter; false excludes mandatory operator-included listings. nearest without coordinates follows existing null-distance/rating/ID ordering.
This public route always uses guest-safe projection, including authenticated callers. Audit authenticated client reliance on search_machines_filtered before replacing it.
x-proposed-changes-requiring-confirmatio: String lengths, types array cap, strict booleans/unknown query rejection and bounds validation are proposed HTTP hardening.

Preserve snake_case guest fields and decimal-rupee listing rate values for compatibility; charged payment DTOs separately use explicit integer minor units. Confirm currency/casing migration with clients.
Public detail route intentionally never switches to private owner projection. Owners use existing owner fleet route.

parameters.description: Repeat types=X&types=Y; active equipment codes, not labels. Proposed cap 50.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: bounds[south], bounds[north], bounds[west], bounds[east]; all four required. west>east crosses antimeridian; south<=north.

post.x-authorization-policy: Verified admitted account and active device session; selected account UUID from trusted token/session mapping; only its own rows. Same-phone individual/company accounts remain isolated. Customer admission required, not a caller-supplied role or customerId.
x-business-rules: Actor resolved from selected admitted customer account. At most one hold per customer; another machine/window replaces previous hold atomically.
Acquire under current database advisory locks/exclusion checks; same live machine/window returns same ID and original expiry, not a sliding renewal. New hold lasts five minutes.
HTTP 200 for acquire-or-reuse: existing RPC does not return a created flag. Map expires_at to expiresAt; server clock is authoritative.

No Idempotency-Key requirement for this operation: current actor/window semantics provide retry behavior while hold lives. After expiry, a retry can acquire a new hold subject to current availability.

Missing/expired hold during subsequent booking submission is recoverable with atomic availability recheck. Live hold with wrong actor/machine/window is HOLD_MISMATCH, not a general HOLD_EXPIRED failure.
Validate date order, booking horizon and single-day timed window; startMinute+durationMinutes<=1440. Availability response before hold is advisory.
x-proposed-changes-requiring-confirmatio: Proposed adapter restricts ordinary holds to the customer booking window: start today..today+29, end-start<=89, start minute360..1080 and duration60..720. Hold SQL helper itself permits a broader window. Confirm any priority/negotiated flow needing different windows before adopting these limits.
Cross-field/relative-date rules and today future-time rule must be implemented in service validation using Asia/Kolkata. No fixed date baked into schemas.
Final identity provider and app/device admission adapter remain unresolved; bearer scheme describes transport only.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque transport contract; identity provider not selected. Server verifies token and selected-account/app/device admission. Never accept self-declared roles. No token issuance specified.

MachinePublic.description: Exact guest RPC field allowlist, retaining snake_case. Nullable fields accommodate historical rows; reconcile hosted types/nullability before freezing. Listing rate numerics are legacy INR rupees, not paise, and are display values only; no financial arithmetic in floating point. No owner, phone, yard coordinates or document fields.

kind.description: Extensible string; known current values documented in services/notificationService.ts. Unknown future kind must not trigger arbitrary navigation or unsafe reads.

x-contract-conventions.unknownFields: Reject unknown body and query fields; OpenAPI parameters do not enforce unknown-query rejection automatically.
x-contract-conventions.queryParsing: Strict true/false booleans, finite numbers and decimal integers. No null query values. Reject repeated scalar parameters; arrays use documented repetition. Decode bounds via explicit safe parser, never arbitrary object merging.
x-contract-conventions.privateCaching: Cache-Control: no-store for protected successes and errors. Public caching only after privacy-aware key and freshness policy are chosen; availability never guaranteed by cache.
x-contract-conventions.requestCorrelation: Server generates meta.requestId/error.requestId and X-Request-Id; sanitize incoming correlation values.
x-contract-conventions.errorMapping: Error status/code names are proposed HTTP translations, not current Postgres error names. Map recognized cases centrally; unknown SQL errors stay sanitized 500.
x-contract-conventions.compatibility: New /v1 adapter and client rollout required. Existing Supabase RPCs/clients are not automatically wire-compatible.
